scope: Retrospective ablation of RTN2, nominated by the prior ten-schedule analysis. Rate fitting uses only the 16 original training single pulses. The earlier held 30-minute single pulse is excluded from calibration.
model: Replace the full input- and state-dependent rate including its on/off switch with a time-invariant rate per original memory channel per seed, shared by that channel's two serial filters. Keep the learned direct and delayed W, target decay, initial states, driver, and scales fixed. Carry all states continuously across pulses and gaps. Average original seeds 416 and 819 at prediction.
calibration: Primary: estimate the three constants jointly by minimizing original training RTN2 post-shutoff MSE, with each of the 16 source schedules weighted equally. Secondary: (i) fit RTN2 across all training times; (ii) fit all seven standardized reporters across all training times. Each fit uses the same rate range 0.05 to 14 per hour as the neural model. Use bounded log-rate least squares with deterministic starts in the three-dimensional rate space; select by source loss only.
test: Use all ten FM schedules from the previous benchmark and the sealed adaptive neural-rate, latent ODE, two-rate and source-mean forecasts as references. Primary RTN2 normalized reporter MSE at 5-minute observations strictly after each last nominal shutoff through minute 120; equal weight to schedules. Report per-schedule scores, win counts and largest differences. Report six/eight pulses and remaining eight separately given the prior question.
checks: Evaluate the common first 40 min of recovery, each seed, and a halved integration time step. Compare training recovery errors to distinguish source approximation from schedule transfer. Verify frozen weights and baselines against archived hashes, source data split, unchanged readout, and independent score/replay calculations.
